en: This is a sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a group of people standing or posing in front of a large, old tree in a field or garden area. The people appear to be well-dressed, possibly for a formal or commemorative photograph. There is handwritten script in Greek around the borders of the postcard, with a prominent band of writing at the top, bottom, and right margin. On the right side is printed vertical text indicating something related to 'Greece' and the 'Great Pine of Kolonaki.'
